crossRefs.note: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass…
He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his…
For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He said to his people, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we.
translations.bsb: “Look,” he said to his people, “the Israelites have become too numerous and too powerful for us.
translations.kjv: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier
translations.asv: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
